莫拉维克悖论：对人越难的，对机器越容易: The Moravec paradox: the harder for people, the easier for machines
红色（左上）：进化练了几亿年的本能，人觉得毫不费力，机器偏偏最难。: Red (top left): instincts evolution spent hundreds of millions of years on. Effortless for us, hardest for machines.
绿色（右下）：文明只发明了几千年的符号运算，人觉得费劲，机器轻松碾压。: Green (bottom right): symbol manipulation, invented by civilisation only a few thousand years ago. Laborious for us, trivial for machines.
